hens_rule_text: Up to 25 rabbits and poultry combined on any premises in a residential or commercial zone.
permit_notes: No permit found for keeping up to 25 birds in a residential zone. A special use permit applies only above 200 birds in a manufacturing zone.
setback_notes: No poultry setback from dwellings was found in the animal chapter. Coops may need to meet accessory structure rules in the zoning code (Chapter 16).
coop_rules: No specific coop standards found in the animal chapter; keep birds from creating a nuisance and confine them to the property.
zoning_notes: The 25-bird cap covers rabbits and poultry together, so rabbits count against the chicken total.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.

sources.name: Oxnard City Code Sec. 5-30 Rabbits or Poultry
Oxnard City Code Sec. 5-2 Declaration of Public Nuisance; Prohibited Acts

research_notes: Facts come from search-result extracts of the American Legal code pages (Sec. 5-30 caps rabbits or poultry at 25 in residential zones; Sec. 5-2 makes a rooster over four months old in a residential zone a public nuisance). The full text could not be opened and no Wayback copy exists, so setbacks and coop rules are unconfirmed.
